name: Springfield Water and Sewer Commission
notification_channel: springfieldalerts.com/Suez (SWSC advisory site, operated with Veolia): email list via Constant Contact 'CSO Notification - Public' (sign-up on the site; not subscribed); live CSO map by Aquasight/ADS embedded at springfieldalerts.com/Suez/index.php/cso-alerts/ (5-minute poll, last 48-56 h only; vendor API needs an X-Dreamfactory-API-Key embedded in the page JS, not used); per-outfall estimate table at /index.php/cso-public-advisory-notice/; SSO and blending pages are blank templates. waterandsewer.org/education/csos/ (24 outfalls).
